forces: The owner authorized on 2026-11-18 a local PoC on LocalStack and a live PoC on AWS in which one business application sends three real authentication events to the collector.
A 2xx answer must mean a stored record, and the server must speak the acknowledgment protocol the Node binding's delivery handoff already classifies.
The collector library keeps zero runtime dependencies, its single SQLite backend, its outcome union and its authenticate-before-read and size-limit ordering.
Stored records are kept for 30 days without breaking the ratified rule that a deployment may decline a retention class but never shorten one.
Database login uses IAM tokens and client-enforced TLS, the endpoint is reachable only by backends inside the network, and no key or payload appears in a response, log or metric.
Required CI stays license-free and green for every slice, and the LocalStack emulation, which validates neither IAM tokens nor TLS, is never a required check.

forces: The collector library keeps zero runtime dependencies, its single SQLite backend, its outcome union and its authenticate-before-read and size-limit ordering.
approach-server-inside-the-collector-pac.reason: It turns the audited library into a network service and removes the gates that keep it narrow; a separate workspace keeps every new dependency and privilege reviewable in one place.

forces: A 2xx answer must mean a stored record, and the server must speak the acknowledgment protocol the Node binding's delivery handoff already classifies.
Stored records are kept for 30 days without breaking the ratified rule that a deployment may decline a retention class but never shorten one.
approach-s3-object-store.reason: Duplicate and conflict decisions would be rebuilt from conditional writes and reads, expiry is asynchronous and unreported, two replicas and SQL reads during the PoC fit a relational store, and the owner chose RDS.

forces: Stored records are kept for 30 days without breaking the ratified rule that a deployment may decline a retention class but never shorten one.
approach-retention-ceiling.reason: It breaks the ratified rule that a deployment never shortens a record's retention, and a stored record would claim a class it is not kept for; the owner chose declining undeclared classes.

forces: The collector library keeps zero runtime dependencies, its single SQLite backend, its outcome union and its authenticate-before-read and size-limit ordering.
approach-server-pre-authenticates.reason: The authenticate-before-read rule would live in two modules and the library could no longer prove it; the owner chose a stream body read by the ingress itself.

forces: A 2xx answer must mean a stored record, and the server must speak the acknowledgment protocol the Node binding's delivery handoff already classifies.
approach-server-own-response-format.reason: The Node binding classifies any 2xx without its exact acknowledgment as malformed, so every stored event would look failed to the producer and retries would never finish.

evidence_ids: collector tests show submit() resolves asynchronously with and without storage, a rejected stream is never read, an oversized stream stops at event_max_bytes, string and stream bodies agree, and two concurrent submissions of one identity give one persisted and one duplicate, each failing on the synchronous ingress

collector tests show an undeclared class is declined with COLLECTOR_RETENTION_CLASS_DECLINED before the port is called, an empty or unknown class fails construction, and no declaration stores all three classes
one storage-port conformance suite passes against SqliteStorage and against PostgresStorage on a postgres CI container, and a severed connection after a sent write reports indeterminate
server tests show an untrusted or mismatched certificate is refused, one IAM token is requested per new connection, and startup refuses local database mode together with the live environment

conformance tests drive createHttpDeliveryHandoff over createFetchHttpExchange with bounded retry against the real server and show a stored event and its retry acknowledged, storage failure retryable, every other rejection permanent, and two replicas storing one record
a server started without storage or with any owner role unnamed exits with a configuration error and never opens its listening port
sentinel values in body, API key, sender and tenant appear in no response, log line or metric, and the metrics port is absent from the load-balanced Service
check-package-discovery passes with the server declared, the server's dependency gate fails on a planted third runtime dependency, and test:coherence passes with the updated workspace statements
the localstack job renders as a skip without LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN and is absent from branch protection's required contexts, and make governance-gates passes on the final technical commit

the server README lists every go-live item from the server spec with its evidence, and SDK tarballs packed from a recorded commit install outside the repository and deliver a synthetic event to the local PoC as persisted
